Moreover, the firm’s investment in U-Tapao Airport project will take years to bear fruit. With no obvious catalysts, we downgraded to SELL. Joint-fare policy is now the most likely scheme The Ministry of Transportation is preparing to propose the principles of the new mass transit “joint-fare of Bt17-45/trip” fare policy to the cabinet soon. This scheme will be applicable to all color -coded train lines and it is targeted to launch in 2027 . The Joint Ticket Fund and the accumulated revenue of the Mass Rapid Transit Authority of Thailand (MRTA) will be used to subsidize the fare differences to the private operators. Under this scenario, we expect the impact on BTS will be neutral with the scope for the upside from potential higher ridership.
